svg.title: The agent loop
svg.desc: The question goes to the model; a reply that asks for a tool makes the tool run as Python on your machine; the result goes back to the model; a reply with no tool call is the answer, shown with its sources. The loop stops after max_iterations rounds.

g.text: OVAT sends it to the model, with the history and a menu of tools.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: OVAT reads the reply. Does it ask for a tool?

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Yes: OVAT runs that tool as ordinary Python, on your own machine.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The tool's result is added to the history.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The model is asked again, now with the result in front of it.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each round can call more tools, until the model has what it needs.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A reply with no tool call is the answer, printed with its sources.

text.style: font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ask the model. If it wants a tool, run it here and add the result. No tool call means the answer.
